name: matlab-2023-lab-edit
notes: The DLD front panel's copy of the MATLAB converter, as the lab had edited it by 2023-08-29. It differs from matlab-2019 in three ways: a 0.5 µs dead time on x1 (an x1 pulse within 0.5 µs after a kept one is dropped), time sums of 3390 bins on X and 3275 on Y for T only, and X and Y worked out from the raw corner times. It finds about 12–14 % fewer hits than matlab-2019 on the lab's sample shots. Choose it to match TXY made with the front panel's edited copy. Not calibrated.
